description_en: Queries the high-availability mode and data replication mode of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的高可用模式和数据复制方式
name: DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

HAMode.description_en:
The High-availability Mode. Valid values:
RPO: Data consistency is preferred. The instance prioritizes data reliability to minimize data loss. Use RPO mode if you have high requirements for data consistency.
RTO: Instance availability is preferred. The instance recovers services as soon as possible to maximize available time. Use RTO mode if you have high requirements for database uptime.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
HAMode.description_zh:
高可用模式，取值：
RPO：数据一致性优先，实例会尽可能保障数据的可靠性，即数据丢失量最少。对于数据一致性要求比较高的用户应该使用RPO模式。
RTO：实例可用性优先，实例会尽快恢复服务，即可用时间最长。对于数据库在线时间要求比较高的用户应该使用RTO模式。

仅MySQL实例返回此参数

NodeInfo.description_en: The information about primary and secondary instances

items.description_en: The details of primary and secondary instances

DataSyncTime.description_en: The time when the secondary instance completed data synchronization by replaying logs. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
DataSyncTime.description_zh: 备实例执行日志完成数据同步的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogSyncTime.description_en: The time when the secondary instance received the instance log from the primary instance. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogSyncTime.description_zh: 备实例收到主实例日志的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

NodeId.description_en: The unique ID of the instance

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
Master: primary node
Slave: secondary node
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，取值：
Master：主节点
Slave：备节点

SyncStatus.description_en:
The synchronization status. Valid values:
NotAvailable: The node is unavailable due to a fault.
Syncing: Synchronization is in progress. A switchover may cause data loss.
Synchronized: Synchronization is complete.
NotSupport: The engine type or version does not support primary/secondary synchronization
SyncStatus.description_zh:
同步状态，取值：
NotAvailable：不可用，即发生故障。
Syncing：同步中，切换可能会发生数据丢失。
Synchronized：完成同步。
NotSupport：引擎类型或者版本不涉及主备同步

SyncMode.description_en:
The data replication mode. Valid values:
Sync: synchronous replication
Semi-sync: semi-synchronous replication
Async: asynchronous replication

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
SyncMode.description_zh:
数据复制方式，取值：
Sync：强同步
Semi-sync：半同步
Async：异步

仅MySQL实例返回此参数
